checks.exercise: Supine alternating dead bug; front/side pose sheets and both encoded final sheets inspected.
checks.equipment: Bodyweight on mat, no external resistance.
checks.setup: Head and trunk stay supported, tabletop knees and arms raised at start. Shorts use matching lining at compressed folds.
checks.hands: Opposite arm reaches overhead, other arm remains above shoulder; no abrupt transition on switching sides.
checks.feet: Opposite leg extends above mat and returns to tabletop; other leg remains stationary.
checks.movement: Both diagonal pairs demonstrated within eight seconds, stable pelvis and upper trunk, seamless loop. 481 joint/mesh samples checked.

checks.exercise: Quadruped opposite-arm/opposite-leg bird dog, alternating sides; diagnostic and encoded sheets inspected.
checks.setup: Hands under shoulders and knees below hips; stable pelvis and head throughout.
checks.hands: Support palm remains fixed; reaching arm blends continuously from support to forward extension.
checks.feet: Support knee remains fixed while opposite leg extends backward and returns. Limbs remain above sampled mat plane.
checks.movement: Alternating diagonal extension with long arms and stable trunk; no pose discontinuity, matching loop endpoints.

checks.exercise: Tabletop-leg reverse crunch with pelvic curl; diagnostic front/side and final light/dark sheets inspected.
checks.equipment: Bodyweight on mat, without handles or weights.
checks.setup: Head and upper trunk remain supported. Bent knees start above hips; garment lining covers compressed folds.
checks.hands: Palms down beside torso, supporting hands remain stationary throughout cycle.
checks.feet: Feet stay suspended with knees held at 90 degrees; legs move toward trunk during pelvic curl.
checks.movement: Pelvis rises 1.5257 model units, pauses one second, and returns under control; no head lifting or hand drift.

limits: Educational procedural motion; simplified clothing and body mesh, not biomechanical certification or exhaustive collision testing.
All nine encoded files passed browser playback/seek/loop and transparent-edge checks. Production and physical-device verification pending.
